programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Why Punish the Children?
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark take on a system that keeps inmate mothers and their children apart.
Mark and Jonathan try to reach a movie star who is a stranger to his own children.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Dream of Wild Horses
programmes.d: The patriarch of a ranch family feels he's too old to rein in some wild horses.
Mark falls for an actress.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: In With the "In" Crowd
programmes.d: A cop is working undercover at a school to put an end to drug use, but faces suspension because of a mistake Mark has made.
Family and friends of a Vietnam veteran won't accept his Amerasian daughter.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: With Love, The Claus
programmes.d: At Christmastime, Jonathan and Mark try to get a divorced couple to work together for their son's sake. Meanwhile, the holiday may be in jeopardy when a department store Santa is arrested.
Jonathan and Mark are bellhops at a hotel that has been given to an aimless young man by his father.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Mother's Love
programmes.d: Four brothers go on the run to escape a court order that would split them up.
Jonathan and Mark try to help a heartless used car salesman reconsider his actions on Christmas Eve.
A country doctor refuses to slow down and seems to be working himself to death.
Investigating a friend's death, Mark encounters drug smugglers; guests Michael Bowen, Lee Bryant.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Time in a Bottle
programmes.d: A district attorney clashes with a lawyer who agrees to defend a friend charged with stealing.
Jonathan attempts to fan the flames of love between a woman and her ex-husband's best friend.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Back to Oakland
programmes.d: Mark returns to Oakland to become a police officer again, and is reunited with his old partner. However, he discovers his old beat has become a storm of racial hatred.
Mark is in a state between life and death when he's critically injured in a car accident.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: We Have Forever - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his former wife when she passes away.
Jonathan steps in when a heart condition sidelines a promising basketball player's dreams.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: We Have Forever - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his former wife when she passes away.
A dying woman tries to reconcile with her stern father for the sake of her illegitimate daughter.
A war correspondent finds himself imprisoned and facing execution. Meanwhile, Jonathan and Mark show him what's he's missed during his life by putting work ahead of family.
Mark and Jonathan's quadriplegic friend falls in love with Mark's cousin.
A Hawaiian singer learns to overcome self-pity after being disabled in a truck accident.
Jonathan arranges an exchange between a pitiless millionaire and a kind vagrant.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Dolphin Song for Lee - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark help a teenage cancer patient named Lee who wants to save the dolphins.
Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten and destroying her family.
Lee's cancer is now in remission. She gets back to work on her save-the-dolphins campaign.
Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Heaven Nose, Mister Smith
programmes.d: Jonathan must stop an angel who's back on Earth with the intention of breaking up his son's marriage.
Jonathan helps a widowed retirement-home resident realize life is worth living.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Whole Nine Yards
programmes.d: A chauvinistic coach doesn't want a female wide receiver on his junior-high football team.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Whose Trash Is It Anyway?
programmes.d: Mark's friend is running for public office, and he's a very honest man. But things get out of hand when an opponent tries to win by going after his son.
Lizzy MacGill is a horse trainer's young daughter who elopes with Garth Armstrong, a privileged man.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Hello and Farewell - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan helps Commander Michaels to deal with flashbacks of Vietnam; he also tries to convince her to go to therapy. Mark deals with his fear of flying.
In the series opener, we meet a probationary angel who has been sent to help people on Earth.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Silent Bell
programmes.d: A pastor must follow a church council's decision to fire most of the staff at the school because they're not Christian.
Jonathan reveals his angelic origins, then must save the senior-citizens home from developers.
Mark attends his high school class reunion and learns that some memories are bittersweet for his old friends.
A terminally ill boy takes in another boy who's continually in trouble with the law.

A teenage girl tells school reporters that a driver came on to her right before the bus got into an accident. She may not be telling the truth. Jonathan tries to teach the news writers the correct way to report a story.
Jonathan and Mark help aging movie heroes to stand up to a street gang known as Satan's Helpers.
The problems of the handicapped are addressed when an amputee joins a crusade after a false fire alarm.
Jonathan and Mark assist a young country singer who is hoping to follow in her mother's footsteps.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Goodbye, Mr. Zelinka
programmes.d: Mr. Zelinka is a beloved teacher who is being forced to retire because he's old. Jonathan and Mark know that he would prefer to continue teaching.
Jonathan must find a way to help a college football star whose dreams are shattered by an accident.
The parents of two Vietnamese children come to America to look for them after a ten-year separation.
Gymnastics rehabilitate a man's (Jim Haynie) paralyzed son (Ken Olandt); guest Bart Conner.
After having been scarred in a fire, an actress becomes a counselor at a summer camp for blind children. The camp is run by Jonathan and Mark's blind friend Frank.
Jonathan (Michael Landon) helps a tycoon who is living in a fantasy. With Victor French.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Inner Limits
programmes.d: A young man decides to institutionalize his brother who has been completely paralyzed and speechless for many years, against the wishes of their mother.
Mark and Jonathan try to reach a movie star who is a stranger to his own children.
